context_for_next_testing_agent: Refactoring complete and verified. The monolithic server.py (6,400+ lines) has been successfully refactored with routes extracted into: 1) routes/messaging.py - 17 endpoints for conversations, messages, quick replies, channel settings, auto-replies, calendar, and send functions (WhatsApp/Telegram/Email). 2) routes/automation.py - 9 endpoints for automation rules CRUD, toggle, run, logs, stats, and preview. 3) routes/dashboard.py - 5 endpoints for dashboard overview, concierge analytics, and space bookings admin. All routes use factory pattern with injected dependencies (db, require_roles, LlmChat, UserMessage, resend). Routers are included in server.py at lines 5047-5054.
